shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -iE 'vite|tsc|vitest'
ls node_modules/@uiw node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -120; ls node_modules | grep -iE 'mark|remark|dompurify|md' ; timeout 20 npm view marked version 2>&1 | tail -2

B=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; ls $B/controls $B/layout; echo ---; sed -n 1,80p $B/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts; echo ---; sed -n 1,60p $B/controls/types.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "export" $B/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,80p $B/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -nE "gap|direction|wrap|grow|alignItems|justifyContent" | head -20; echo ---; sed -n 1,60p $B/Text/Text.d.ts; echo; grep -n "variant" $B/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; cat $B/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -30

grep -ohE -- '--g-color-(base-generic|base-generic-hover|line-generic|text-secondary|text-link|text-primary|base-misc-light|base-background|base-simple-hover)\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/; grep -ohE -- '--g-spacing-[0-9]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/variables.css | sort -u | head; grep -rn "SegmentedRadioGroup\|export \* from './Alert'\|export \* from './Card'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/; grep -ohE -- '--g-color-(base-generic|line-generic|text-secondary|text-link|text-primary|base-misc-light|base-background|base-generic-ultralight|base-float)\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/*.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u; grep -ohE -- '--g-spacing-[0-9]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css | sort -u; grep -ohE -- '--g-border-radius-[a-z]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css | sort -u; grep -ohE -- '--g-text-code-font-family' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css | sort -u

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/markdown/parse.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("level: atx[1].length as BlockNode & { type: 'heading' } extends { level: infer L } ? L : never,","level: atx[1].length as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6,")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "level: atx" src/markdown/parse.ts

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/Alert.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -nE "title|message|theme|onClose|layout" | head -20; grep -n "color?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "hint\|secondary" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -5; grep -nE "checked|disabled|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -8
sed -i 's|"dev": "vite"|"dev": "vite",\n    "test": "vitest run"|' package.json && cat package.json | sed -n 5,9p && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -60
npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15
npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -A40 "\[1/3\]" | head -60

grep -n "// \*\*жирный\*\*" src/markdown/parse.ts; grep -n "^    buf += ch;$" src/markdown/parse.ts; grep -n "^function findCloser" src/markdown/parse.ts; grep -n "^interface BracketLink" src/markdown/parse.ts; grep -n "if (sawBlank && i < lines.length && LIST_RE.test" src/markdown/parse.ts
sed -n 425,470p src/markdown/parse.ts && echo ======= && sed -n 496,538p src/markdown/parse.ts
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome playwright 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; echo "browser check done"
npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -40
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -12; echo; git status --short; rm -rf dist
npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -B5 -A12 "AssertionError" | head -40
sed -i 's|жирным|жирный|' src/App.test.tsx && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -8 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && rm -rf dist && git status --short
